Jordan — thanks for the clear summary. Confirming a few items from our side:

- For backups: we understand immediate purges from primary stores may be constrained by backup immutability policies. Nimbus' policy requires the vendor to make best-effort purges and to ensure no further restores make deleted data accessible; a hard-delete from backups within 90 days is preferred if possible.
- Audit: we need an auditable deletion event record with request ID, executor (service account), timestamp, affected object IDs, and confirmation of purge from primary store.

Open follow-ups for you: can Redwood provide a recommended SLA matrix (acknowledge / primary purge / backup purge windows) and an explanation of what 'best-effort purge' means operationally for your managed service? Also please flag any data-residency constraints — we need confirmation that deletion pipelines for EU resident data will not cross regions during processing.

Neha/Marissa — forwarding Olivia's confirmation and asks. Key asks: SLA matrix (acknowledge / primary purge / backup purge), audit log fields, and data-residency constraint (EU data pipeline must not cross regions).

Olivia: I looped in Neha (security/infra) and Marissa (CS/contract). Neha — can you draft a short technical note describing:

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Olivia Ramos <olivia.ramos@nimbushealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-22T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Next steps: deletion request process, backups & audit logs

Jordan/Olivia/Marissa — see answers below and attached examples. Attaching redwood-deletion-patterns.pdf and s3-retention-sample.csv.

Summary answers:
1) Acknowledgement SLA: we can provide automated acknowledgement within 24 hours for API-submitted requests or same-business-day for emailed/CSR requests.
2) Primary stores: most primary data (S3-style object stores, KV caches) will be deleted within 0-72 hours once the deletion job is run. Embeddings stored in vector stores are soft-deleted (deleted flag + immediate exclusion from query results) and compacted in the next weekly maintenance window (typically 7 days).
3) Backups: we operate snapshot-based backups (weekly full / daily incremental depending on plan). Snapshots are immutable by design which prevents in-place deletion. For enterprise customers we offer two mitigations: (a) accelerated retention shortening (contractually reduced snapshot retention to 90 days), or (b) crypto-erase via key-rotation to render snapshot data unreadable — effective immediately once rotation completes. Crypto-erase is the fastest way to make data irrecoverable.
4) Audit logs: we already emit deletion events with the following fields: request_id, requestor_email, timestamp_iso, affected_object_ids (list), action_type (soft-delete|hard-delete|crypto-erase), and outcome (success|partial|failed). We can surface these to Nimbus via secure S3 export or SIEM integration (Splunk/Datadog).
5) Data residency: deletion pipelines are region-aware. For EU-resident data we ensure deletion jobs are executed in-region and do not copy data out-of-region during processing. Any administrative tooling that needs cross-region metadata access can be restricted via role-based access controls.

Caveats & notes:
- "Immediate" removal from primary stores is subject to in-flight requests; we ensure new requests will not return deleted items once a deletion marker is set, but long-running inferences may still reference cached context until eviction.
- Backup purges depend on the snapshot retention configuration; for contractual 90-day backup purge we need an addendum specifying the reduced retention plus a small operational fee (this is because we change snapshot schedules and retention policies).

Next steps action items (by owner):
- Neha: prepare a 1-page technical note (2-3 diagrams) summarizing deletion flow and backup options, plus a sample audit log export (due EOD Thurs).
- Marissa: draft proposed SLA language and pricing addendum for 90-day backup purge option (due Fri).
- Jordan: propose 3 meeting slots for a 30-minute follow-up with Nimbus security team.

Olivia — does this address your asks at a high level? Happy to surface more detail in the technical note.

Regards,
